integrity: The proof is structural; finite enumeration and exact power-series checks are supplied only as reproducibility checks. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The Greg-tree sequence and its generating function are classical; the claimed contribution is the identification with the universal homogeneous meet-tree tuple-orbit profile. Literature search does not prove priority, and no asymptotic claim is made.
title: Greg-tree orbit profile of the universal homogeneous meet-tree
